title: Need fast portable storage? The Verbatim Pocket 1TB SSD is down to $139.99
summary: The Verbatim Pocket 1TB SSD is $40 off right now, bringing fast USB-C storage and a travel-friendly design for less.
body: The Verbatim Pocket 1TB SSD is built for people who want fast storage in a drive that can go anywhere, and there’s a good deal on it at Amazon right now. This ultra-compact portable SSD gives you 1TB of extra space in a body small enough to slip into a pocket or bag without taking up much room. See the deal at Amazon
